mission: Publish Company AI Hub as an Apache-2.0 open-source project with reviewed external contributions and evidence-backed promotion.
acceptance: Repository is public under Apache-2.0 with no committed credentials or private data
External contributors can submit pull requests with documented expectations
Main branch requires passing checks and maintainer review before merge
Repository exposes citation metadata, contribution templates, security reporting, description, and topics
Any third-party promotion follows the target repository's contribution rules
Fresh build, tests, independent review, remote-rule checks, and final diff verification pass
authorityBoundary: Owner authorized public release under Apache-2.0 and reviewed pull requests; no production deployment or unsolicited third-party promotion outside explicit repository rules.
